title: A Cure for Heart Trouble
summaryZh: 我們若硬著心必走向滅亡；但神會衡量人心，並藉聖靈與寶血來預備、開啟，賜給我們新心。
lines: He broke his promise every time and he hardened his heart.
他每一次都違背諾言，並且硬著心。
And let me tell you something.
The Bible says, "He that hardeneth his heart, being often reproved, shall suddenly be cut off and that without remedy."
聖經說：「人屢次受責罰，仍然硬著頸項；他必頃刻敗壞，無法可治。」
In other words, there will come the last time that you harden your heart and it will all be over.
換句話說，總會有最後一次你硬著心，然後一切就結束了。
There will be no more chance for you.
Because, you see, when you harden your heart, it builds a little ring around it.
因為你看，當你硬著心的時候，心裡就會結出一層硬殼。
And the Holy Spirit may speak to you again, but your heart will be harder.
聖靈可能再次對你說話，但你的心會變得更硬。
It will be like Pharaoh's heart getting harder and harder every time,
這就像法老的心每一次都變得越來越硬，
until when God speaks to you, you can no longer hear Him.
直到當神對你說話時，你再也聽不見祂。
God takes our heart out and ponders it.
神把我們的心拿出來，並且衡量它。
Think of the Almighty God studying your heart.
想像一下全能的神在審視你的心。
"Every way of a man is right in his own eyes, but the Lord pondereth the heart." Proverbs 21:2.
「人所行的，在自己眼中都看為正；惟有耶和華衡量人心。」箴言二十一章2節。
The scripture says, "If thou sayest, Behold we know it not;
聖經說：「你若說：這事我未曾知道，
doth not he that pondereth the heart consider it,
那衡量人心的豈不明白嗎？
and he that keepeth thy soul, doeth he not know it,
保守你命的豈不知道嗎？
and shall not he render to every man according to his works?"
祂豈不按各人所行的報應各人嗎？」
How do you stand before God?
你在神面前站立得住嗎？
Is your heart right with God?
你的心在神面前端正嗎？
Then the Bible says He weighs the heart and tries the heart.
然後聖經說，祂衡量人心，試驗人心。
What do you mean He weighs the heart?
祂衡量人心是什麼意思？
Well, He weighs your heart by the Ten Commandments.
嗯，祂用十誡來衡量你的心。
He weighs it by the Sermon on the Mount.
祂用登山寶訓來衡量它。
He weighs it by the great law that we just read.
祂用我們剛才讀的偉大律法來衡量它。
He weighs it by the life of Christ.
祂用基督的生平來衡量它。
He weighs it by the teachings of Scripture on the way we ought to live.
祂用聖經中關於我們應當如何生活的教導來衡量它。
All the way through the scriptures we read about the blood of Jesus Christ.
縱觀整本聖經，我們都讀到關於耶穌基督的寶血。
Somebody said, "Don't you think that the scriptures have too much about blood?"
有人說：「你不覺得聖經裡講了太多關於血的事嗎？」
Some have called it a slaughterhouse religion.
有些人稱之為屠宰場宗教。
There is a lot about blood in the scriptures.
聖經裡確實有很多關於血的記載。
But the Bible says without the shedding of blood there is no forgiveness of sins.
但聖經說，若不流血，罪就不得赦免了。
If Jesus Christ had not died on that cross and shed His blood for you,
如果耶穌基督沒有死在那十字架上為你流血，
there's no way you could be forgiven of your sins.
你的罪就絕不可能得到赦免。
It means that His heart bled and it is only through the cleansing of that blood that we can be forgiven.
這意味著祂的心流血了，而且只有透過那寶血的潔淨，我們才能得赦免。
And then the Bible says God prepares the heart by the Holy Spirit.
然後聖經說，神藉著聖靈預備人心。
Your heart's already been prepared for this meeting tonight.
為了今晚的這個聚會，你的心已經被預備好了。
He prepares for the many experiences in your life.
祂為你生命中的許多經歷做預備。
The Bible says the preparations of the heart in man are from the Lord.
聖經說，人心裡的預備是出於耶穌和華。
Many of the experiences that you thought were terrible was God preparing you.
許多你以為很可怕的經歷，其實是神在預備你。
The Bible says He opens the heart.
使徒行傳十六章14節：「主就開導她的心。」
How wonderful for God to prepare the heart, then open the heart.
神預備人心，然後開啟人心，這是何等奇妙。
The eyes of your understanding being enlightened.
Without the enlightenment, the opening and preparation by the Holy Spirit, no one could receive Christ.
若沒有聖靈的光照、開啟和預備，沒有人能接受基督。
You see, salvation is of the Lord.
你看，救恩是出於耶和華。
We receive, but it's all of God.
我們只是領受，但這全是出於神。
He's the one who gave His Son on the cross.
是祂將自己的兒子賜下在十字架上。
He's the one who sent the Holy Spirit to convict you.
是祂差遣聖靈來使你知罪。
He's the one that made it possible for you to come here tonight so you can receive Him into your heart.
是祂使你今晚能來到這裡，好讓你能將祂接待到你心裡。
And the Bible says that He gives a new heart.
聖經也說，祂賜下一顆新心。
God says an old heart will not do.
You have to have a new one and God doesn't just patch you up.
你必須有一顆新的心，而神不會只是把你修補一下。
"A new heart also will I give you, and a new spirit will I put within you.
「我也要賜給你們一個新心，將新靈放在你們裡面。
I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you a heart of flesh."
又從你們的肉體中除掉石心，賜給你們肉心。」
God says a new heart is what you need.
神說你需要的是一顆新心。
Have you received this new heart from God?
你從神那裡領受這顆新心了嗎？
You say, "Now Billy, I've been baptized, I've been confirmed, and I try to live a good life.
你說：「那麼比利，我已經受洗了，也堅振了，我也努力過一個好生活。
I don't succeed, but I try.
我沒有成功，但我盡力了。
And I try to get to Sunday School once in a while and I go to church,
我偶爾也盡量去主日學，我也去教會，
or I watch on television some church service."
或者我在電視上看一些教會的禮拜。」
